PROPOSED ORDER GRANTING LEAVE TO FILE NOTICE
OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Notice of Subsequent
Record Development Relevant to Pending Rule 72(a) Objections. The Court has considered the
Motion and the Memorandum in Support. For good cause shown, it is hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that the Notice of Subsequent Record Development attached to the Motion as
Exhibit A is deemed filed and shall be considered with Plaintiff’s pending Rule 72(a) Objections,
ECF No. 66.

It is SO ORDERED.
